CONTINUED ATTACK: SHARP READOUT CONTROL, WITH THE ADVANTAGE CLAIM TESTED
1 November 2026

Civilisation-changing capability: NOT_ACHIEVED.
New derivations: completed at their explicit mathematical model scope, with
solo executable self-checks. Independent audit NOT_PERFORMED. Novelty UNKNOWN.
No physical platform or practical superiority has been qualified.

The strongest new candidate is an exact photon-count theorem for unprepared,
mutable quantum control sources. It is retained, but NOT selected as a mission
win: a matched ordinary fault-path analysis already gives the qualitative
encoded-readout capability at the same encoding level. This pass therefore
does not substitute a convenient certifiable separation for the requested impact.

What was actually derived and constructed

For initially empty receiver modes, exchange
 H=H_E+sum_i (a_i^dag b_i+b_i^dag a_i) tensor G_i(t)
can have arbitrarily correlated controllers, source backaction and arbitrarily
fast noncommuting H_E. If integral g_i=pi/2 and
 A_i=integral ||G_i-g_i I||<pi/2, then its observed count generating functions
are bounded by those of loss with transmission lambda_i=cos^2 A_i. In
particular, with collection eta and fixed m input photons,

 P(no photon detected) <=[1-eta cos^2 A]^m.

The constants are sharp, achieved by scalar gain error. A positive relative
gain interval 1+-delta gives A<=pi delta/2. Multiple simultaneous reads obey
product bounds for selected missed photons even when their gain operators
share a source and do not commute. The proof turns exact source propagators
into Bernstein finite differences; the Bernstein inequality is established
prior. It does not approximate the controller by a classical random number.

I built a full destructive dual-rail measurement instrument, carried a reused
quantum source through 34,992 encoded measurement histories, and checked the
source-retaining Choi matrix including an arbitrary reference. Then I derived
conditional joint error bounds from actual local thermal GKSL dynamics and
an exact charge-block Poisson representation. The parallel implementation can
have three-local interactions and bounded degree, with unreset correlated
controller spins. The observation duration stays fixed as encoding grows.

GOVERNING SOURCES AND MATCHED COMPARATORS
1 November 2026. Local byte identities and page counts are in verification.json.
Cached PDFs are not represented as having been read end to end. Passages below
state what was actually used. Historical novelty has not been established.

Mathematical tool used for the new exact bound

Aleksandrov and Peller, Functions of perturbed unbounded self-adjoint operators.
Operator Bernstein type inequalities, arXiv:1003.3982v1 (2010).
 https://arxiv.org/abs/1003.3982
Read section 5.1, PDF pp.16-18, particularly (5.2),(5.3), Banach-valued Lemma
5.1. Formula page 17 was also rendered and visually checked. The sharp
entire-function finite-difference inequality is theirs/Bernstein's.
Our proposed contribution is the exact quantum-source representation, virtual-
photon and multivariable reductions, and the measured physical fault bounds.
The source theorem itself is not new. Bounded searches did not locate an exact
matching statement, but that absence is not a novelty or priority proof.

The decisive stronger ordinary comparator

Aliferis, Gottesman and Preskill, Quantum accuracy threshold for concatenated
distance-3 codes, arXiv:quant-ph/0504218v3, 21 October 2005.
 https://arxiv.org/abs/quant-ph/0504218
Read section 11.1, PDF pp.47-49: shared quantum bath, arbitrary bath Hamiltonian,
no bath-locality assumption, Hamiltonian decomposition (53)-(58), fault-set
operator norm (59). The arXiv text is readable. The journal PDF from Preskill's
site has broken font extraction and was not used in place of those readable
passages. Generic non-Markovian fault tolerance already permits correlations.

Apply that ordinary local fault-path bound to the SAME virtual photons and
project onto each selected miss. Their probability is <=A^(2k). This gives
the same generating-function comparison with A^2 replacing sin^2 A. The
thermal model and code are then exactly identical in the two calculations.
matched_controls.json shows the same minimum encoding level for the declared
accuracy target. This specific comparator prevents a qualitative capability
claim based only on our sharper constant. Terhal-Burkard quant-ph/0402104 was
also screened as earlier context; no stronger locality claim was imported.

Conclusive quantum transfer is an incumbent too

Burgarth and Bose, Conclusive and arbitrarily perfect quantum-state transfer
using parallel spin-chain
